title: CampusLife contract schema vocabulary
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 plus the contract's x- keywords. Every schema under schemas/ must validate against this, at every nesting level.

x-owner.description: Who writes this property (D1): hub = Hub code only, user = Mutations only, client = the creating client.

x-text.description: Long text: patches carry from_hash instead of from (E11).

x-box-extent.description: Rule box_extent: a [x, y, w, h] box stays inside the unit square (x+w <= 1, y+h <= 1).

x-calendar-date.description: Rule calendar: the YYYY-MM-DD the string starts with is a real calendar date (2023-02-29 is not).

x-tz-exists.description: Rule tz_exists: the string names a zone in the IANA tz database as shipped by the PyPI tzdata package.

x-range-order.description: Rule range_order: for each pair present, the start member is <= (strict: <) the end member.

x-raw-form.description: Rule raw_form: for each pair present, the raw member is the received, non-NFC form of the text member (raw != text and NFC(raw) == text).

x-relation-id.description: Rule relation_id: id equals from|type|to (D18, E14). true when the three sit next to id, otherwise the name of the member holding them.

x-batch-order.description: Rule batch_order: in a batch response, every result after the first retry is not_attempted and none before it is (E12).

x-original-id.description: Rule original_id: a result's original carries the same mutation_id as the result (E12).

x-open.description: An enum the Hub may grow: any value matching the pattern decodes, and examples lists the known values, the only ones a client may write (rule set_type).

x-feed-order.description: Rule feed_order: in a changes page, each row's id is its data's id, revs rise strictly, and next_since is at least the highest rev (E18).

x-chunk-index.description: Rule chunk_index: in an upload session, every received index is below the chunk count, ceil(size / chunk_size) (E19).

x-relation-not-self.description: Rule relation_self: from and to are different entities.

x-set-targets.description: Per entity, the entity schema a patch's set writes and, if it has kind fields, the fields schemas a fields.<key> may belong to. Read by rules owner and set_type.

x-set-owner.description: Rule owner: set writes no column the entity schema marks x-owner hub (E5). Needs x-set-targets.

x-set-type.description: Rule set_type: each set key is a column of the entity, from and to fit it, to is null only for an optional column, and x-text columns compare by from_hash (E6, A3). Needs x-set-targets.

discriminator.description: OpenAPI discriminator. mapping names, for every value of the discriminator's enum, the one oneOf branch ($ref) it selects.

patternProperties.description: Not used by the contract: jsonschema matches member names with Python re, not ECMA-262.
